items.t: Horror con Spooky Empire happens in Orlando over Halloween weekend
items.x: Horror con Spooky Empire, much like a good slasher-flick villain, is back for another installment in Orlando on Halloween weekend.

items.t: Court suggests Florida teacher shouldn’t be punished for celebrating Charlie Kirk’s death
items.x: A Florida judge last week recommended dismissing a misconduct case against a Clay County teacher for a post celebrating Kirk's death.

items.t: Uthmeier says property risk-assessment company ‘is marketing fear to advance a climate activism agenda’
items.x: Florida has sued a company that issues climate change assessments of property risks including flooding that the state alleges are deceptive

items.t: Genitorturers make Halloween heavy in Orlando
items.x: Cult legends the Genitorturers are returning to their birthplace of Orlando to punish us so good again with their BDSM rock spectacle.

items.t: Organist Cameron Carpenter conjures symphony of horror to soundtrack ‘Nosferatu’
items.x: Between the haunting shadows of Murnau’s Nosferatu and Carpenter’s esoteric accompaniment, this silent film promises to make plenty of noise.

items.t: The Nook celebrates its last night open with a Halloween funeral party
items.x: The Nook on Robinson is closing on Halloween night and, fittingly for a space that has never shied away from a good conceptual soiree, with a funeral-themed party.

items.t: Man accused of fleeing from Volusia deputies, bailing out of vehicle, fighting K-9
items.x: A man who fled from deputies was taken into custody Wednesday night near the entrance of the Canaveral National Seashore, according to the Volusia Sheriff's Office.

items.t: Deputies: Wanted man flees, hides in palm fronds before K-9 arrest
items.x: A man with an outstanding warrant was caught by deputies and a K-9 hiding in palm fronds at Canaveral National Seashore.

items.t: Hegseth fires the Pentagon's top military planner even as Trump considers new Iran strikes
items.x: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has fired the Pentagon’s top military planner.

items.t: Justice Department announces Trump plans for golf course are in the works, course will close Nov. 15
items.x: The Justice Department has filed notice that President Donald Trump’s announcements that there are plans for renovating the East Potomac Golf Course and there are plans to close the park beginning Nov. 15 are accurate.

items.t: Orlando Magic fall behind early in 129-99 loss to Toronto Raptors
items.x: The Orlando Magic fell 129-99 to the Toronto Raptors behind strong performances from RJ Barrett and Scottie Barnes.

items.t: Chicago rapper LoWick, 22, killed in FBI shooting in Dixmoor
items.x: Chicago rapper LoWick, 22, was killed in an FBI-involved shooting during a law enforcement operation in Dixmoor Wednesday, leaving his family questioning why agents opened fire.

items.t: Bunnell ‘Project Butterfly’ landfill proposal scrapped amid local pushback
items.x: It was a major victory on Wednesday night for people who have been railing against a controversial landfill project in Bunnell.

items.t: Man in custody after 2 shot, killed in Ocala, police say
items.x: A man was taken into custody after two other men were fatally shot Wednesday in Ocala, according to police.
